rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their violent conduct shows they live as if death will not come; it is followed by evidence that they expect no recompense.
rows.anchor: ولما بين أن عملهم عمل من لا يخاف الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They seize people in punitive violence without concern for killing or any other consequence.
rows.anchor: أخذتموه أخذ سطوة في عقوبة

rows.speaker: البغوي
rows.claim: Al-Baghawi defines a tyrant as one who strikes and kills in anger.
rows.anchor: قال البغوي : والجبار الذي يضرب ويقتل على الغضب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their violent defiance leads to a call to fear God, possessor of majesty and bounty, and obey His messenger.
rows.anchor: أي الذي له جميع صفات الجلال والإكرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Imdād is providing support by following one thing with what strengthens it and helps it function in order.
rows.anchor: هو إتباع الشيء بما يقويه على الانتظام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering beneficence should bring submission; the blessings are obvious, leaving no excuse for neglecting gratitude.
rows.anchor: ولما كان ادكار الإحسان موجبا للإذعان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Livestock help them work and provide food or goods to sell.
rows.anchor: أي تعينكم على الأعمال وتأكلون منها وتبيعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sons help them accomplish what they want when they are unable to do it themselves.
rows.anchor: أي يعينونكم على ما تريدون عند العجز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The orchards are thickly planted and conceal their interior; springs keep them irrigated.
rows.anchor: بساتين ملتفة الشجار بحيث تستر داخلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He fears for his own people because their harm grieves him as his own harm would.
rows.anchor: لأنكم قومي يسوءني ما يسوءكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling the day great intensifies the warning more than directly calling the punishment great.
rows.anchor: وتعظيم اليوم أبلغ من تعظيم العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Out of self-admiration, they say warning or silence makes no difference; they will not obey him.
rows.anchor: راضين بما عندهم من داء الإعجاب , الموقع في كل ما عاب

rows.speaker: البغوي
rows.claim: Al-Baghawi defines admonition as speech that softens the heart by recalling promise and threat.
rows.anchor: كلام يلين القلب بذكر الوعد والوعيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is stronger than asking if he merely admonished: it challenges whether he is qualified and counted among established preachers.
rows.anchor: فهو أبلغ من ( أم لم تعظ )

rows.speaker: ابن كثير وأبو عمرو والكسائي
rows.claim: Ibn Kathir, Abu Amr, and al-Kisa'i read khalq with fatḥa on khāʾ and sukūn on lām; it can mean the ancients' fabrication or customary way of life.
rows.anchor: بفتح الخاء وإسكان اللام في قراءة ابن كثير وأبي عمرو والكسائي

rows.speaker: الباقون
rows.claim: The remaining readers use ḍamma on khāʾ and lām, supporting the sense of the ancients' customary way of life.
rows.anchor: وعليه تدل قراءة الباقين بضم الخاء واللام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They deny being punishable because they think themselves strong, brave, and formidable.
rows.anchor: لأنا أهل قوة وشجاعة ونجدة وبراعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God destroyed them with the wind, whose might eclipsed their own strength.
rows.anchor: أي بالريح بما لنا من العظمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Destruction of the disobedient and rescue of the obedient is a sign that God vindicates truth and frustrates falsehood; His allies are not humiliated and His enemies do not prevail.
rows.anchor: الإهلاك في كل قرن للعاصين والإنجاء للطائعين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most people who came after them were unbelievers, so the Prophet should not grieve over those who turn away from faith.
rows.anchor: أي أكثر من كان بعدهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is mighty in requital and merciful in benefaction, honor, and kindness despite people's disobedience and disbelief.
rows.anchor: في إنعامه وإكرامه وإحسانه , مع عصيانه وكفرانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sends messengers backed by miracles to show the straight path and destroys only after the fullest warning establishes proof.
rows.anchor: وإرسال المنذرين وتأييدهم بالآيات المعجزة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because humans are prone to forget, he next reminds them of the preceding lesson through the example of Thamud.
rows.anchor: ثم ذل على ذلك لمن قد ينسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Thamud's abrupt denial, without reflection or pause, increases consolation to Muhammad.
rows.anchor: وأشار إلى زيادة التسلية بمفاجأتهم بالتكذيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Salih was known to them for truthfulness, trustworthiness, compassion, and integrity.
rows.anchor: الذي يعرفون صدقه وأمانته , وشفقته وصيانته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Salih begins with a gentle, invitational appeal asking whether they will take heed.
rows.anchor: أشار إلى تلطفه بهم بقوله على سبيل العرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Salih explains that he speaks because God sent him and commissioned him to deliver this warning.
rows.anchor: فلذلك عرضت عليكم هذا لأني مأمور بذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He has no trace of treachery and sincerely conveys all that his Creator sent him to deliver.
rows.anchor: بل أنصح لكم في إبلاغ جميع ما أرسلت به إليكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because Salih has established his commission, he calls them to fear God; because he is trustworthy, he calls them to obey him.
rows.anchor: ولما ذكر الأمانة قال : { وأطيعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He denies seeking payment, removing the usual reason to suspect a messenger of self-interest.
rows.anchor: أي إني لكم كذا والحال أني ما

words: إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His reward comes only from the Lord of all worlds, the benefactor of all, from whom he asks what He grants them.
rows.anchor: منه أطلب أن يعطيني كما أعطاهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He reproaches them for surrendering to appetite and luxury, content with what passes away.
rows.anchor: منكرا عليهم إخلادهم إلى شهوة البطن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He asks whether they think they are secure from calamities controlled only by God while brazenly defying the overpowering King.
rows.anchor: من أيدي النوائب التي لا يقدر عليها إلا الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gardens conceal entrants under abundant trees; springs irrigate them and add beauty and benefit.
rows.anchor: بساتين تستر الداخل فيها وتخفيه لكثرة أشجارها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The talʿ is the fruit that emerges from the palm.
rows.anchor: أي ما يطلع منها من الثمر

rows.speaker: الزمخشري
rows.claim: Al-Zamakhshari compares the shoots within the fruit spathe to a sword blade; qinw is the whole cluster growing from the trunk with stem and branches.
rows.anchor: قال الزمخشري : كنصل السيف في جوفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He prefers the sense generous and abundant, from the expression for a hand that gives freely, as a sense gathering the scholars' explanations.
rows.anchor: جواد كريم من قولهم : يد هضوم

rows.speaker: أبو عبد الله القزاز
rows.claim: Al-Qazzaz says the fruit is pressed closely together, implying abundance, dense arrangement, tenderness, and pleasant scent.
rows.anchor: ما قال أبو عبد الله القزاز معناه أنه قد هضم

rows.speaker: الرازي
rows.claim: Al-Razi gives ripe, mature, soft fruit that crumbles when touched, or food that digests readily; the senses converge on delicacy.
rows.anchor: قال الرازي في اللوامع : أو يانع نضيج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Related forms of the root evoke bodily softness, digestion, incense, and perfume blended with musk and frankincense.
rows.anchor: والهاضم وهو ما فيه رخاوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After delicate comforts he turns to strenuous deeds: carving mountain homes displays power and pride, not genuine need.
rows.anchor: ولما ذكر اللطيف من أحوالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fārihīn describes them displaying energy and strength.
rows.anchor: أي مظهرين النشاط والقوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their blessings should lead them to shield themselves from punishment through obedience; the messenger orders what benefits them and preserves their gifts.
rows.anchor: بأن تجعلوا بينكم وبين عذابه وقاية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The profligates exceeded limits until excess became their settled character.
rows.anchor: أي المتجاوزين للحدود الذي صار لهم ذلك خلقا

words: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They cause pure corruption because their actions are not firmly grounded in God.
rows.anchor: يعملون ما يؤدي إلى الفساد لكونه غير محكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He also allows that their evil foundation makes none of their work truly good despite appearances, or that profligacy combines corruption and failure to repair.
rows.anchor: أن المسرف من كان عريقا في الإسراف بجمع هذين الأمرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They try to mislead weak minds by saying repeated magic overwhelmed Salih despite his human body and lungs.
rows.anchor: الذين بولغ في سحرهم مرة بعد مرة

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas, quoted by al-Baghawi, explains the word as created people sustained by food and drink; saharahu can mean feeding someone.
rows.anchor: ونقل البغوي عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما أن معنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their appending one description to another without conjunction suggests they are not firmly resolved to deny him.
rows.anchor: وإتباعهم الوصف الوصف من غير عطف عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The descriptions function as a single expression, like calling something sweet and sour to mean bitter, indicating doubt rather than settled denial.
rows.anchor: قالوصفان عندهم بمنزلة شيء واحد

words: فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask for a sign to establish his truth, still speaking conditionally rather than asserting settled disbelief; this contrasts with their later response to Shu'ayb.
rows.anchor: اي علامة تدلنا على صدقك

words: فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Biqāʿī contrasts their uncertain response with the later story of Shu'ayb.
rows.anchor: بخلاف ما يأتي قريبا في قصة شعيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God swiftly answered their request by bringing a pregnant she-camel out of the rock, as they had proposed.
rows.anchor: فأتوا فأخرج الله له من الصخرة ناقة عشراء كما اقترحوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The near demonstrative points to how easily and quickly God brought the camel out of the rock.
rows.anchor: بأداة القرب إشارة إلى سهولة إخراجها وسرعته

words: لَهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The camel drinks all the well water on her assigned day and leaves it to them on the next, so each takes a share without competition.
rows.anchor: تشرب ماء البئر كله في يوم وردها وتكف عنه في اليوم الثاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The camel and people each have a fixed allotment of water on a known day.
rows.anchor: أي نصب من الماء في يوم معلوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They must not harm her in any way, however slight, because what comes from God deserves honor, care, and respect.
rows.anchor: كائنا ما كان وإن قل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The punishment comes on the great day itself, a stronger formulation than merely describing the punishment as great.
rows.anchor: بسبب ما حل فيه من العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They killed the camel by striking her leg with a sword.
rows.anchor: أي قتلوها بضرب ساقها بالسيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They regretted killing her because they realized it would bring destruction, not because they repented of disobeying God and His messenger.
rows.anchor: ندمهم على قتلها من حيث إنه يفضي إلى الهلاك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says the punishment arrived while they were trying to kill Salih, showing that regret came only when calamity appeared and could no longer help.
rows.anchor: نقل عنهم أنه أتاهم العذاب العذاب وهو يحاولون أن يقتلوا صالحا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The threatened punishment seized them.
rows.anchor: العذاب } اي المتوعد به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The camel and the approaching signs of punishment were decisive evidence that Salih's command came from God.
rows.anchor: في الناقة وفي حلول المخايل كما تقدم أعظم دليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even with this sign, most of them did not believe.
rows.anchor: أي والحال أنه مع ذلك ما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's failure to coerce them into belief does not diminish His might, and their destruction does not negate His mercy.
rows.anchor: غير متصف بالعزة لعدم قسرهم على الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He is merciful because He does not destroy anyone until a messenger explains what God approves and rejects and completes the warning establishing proof.
rows.anchor: لم يهلك أحدا حتى ارسل إليهم رسولا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated refrain confirms that later peoples disbelieve without learning from earlier examples; it consoles the Prophet, warns the wise, and appeals to compassionate hearts.
rows.anchor: سبحانه هذه الآية آخر كل قصة على وجه التأكيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their denial of one messenger counts as denial of all because the miracles equally establish truth; the verse explicitly states their unbelief.
rows.anchor: لتساوي المعجزات في الدلالة على الصدق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot was their brother by residence, not lineage: he was Abraham's nephew from Babylon.
rows.anchor: أي في السكنى في البلد لا في النسب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His long residence, marriage into their community, children with their women, and shared rural life explain the description as brother.
rows.anchor: وكأنه عبر بالأخوة لاختياره لمجاورتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The appeal asks whether they fear God enough to protect themselves from His displeasure.
rows.anchor: أي تخافون الله فتجعلوا بينكم وبين سخطه وقاية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot explains his warning by his commission as their messenger and his freedom from deceit or treachery.
rows.anchor: ولذلك سبب عنه قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear God because He can destroy whom He wills; obey Lot because obedience brings safety and he commands only what God approves.
rows.anchor: أي لقدرته على إهلاك من يريد وتعاليه في عظمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot's call to God earns no payment from them, so they cannot accuse him of preaching for a fee.
rows.anchor: أي الدعاء إلى الله { من أجر

words: إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His reward is only from the Lord of the worlds, who created and nurtures them.
rows.anchor: أي المحسن إليهم بإيجادهم ثم تربيتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He rebukes them for choosing sexual appetite in a way that has made them infamous among creation.
rows.anchor: إيثارهم شهوة الفرج المخرج لهم إلى ما صاروا به سبة في الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One possibility is that their transgression extended to males of other species, intensifying their evil and shamelessness.
rows.anchor: ولعلهم كانوا يفعلون بالذكور من غير الآدميين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, among all creatures they alone chose males, unlike other creatures that seek female mates.
rows.anchor: أو يكون المعنى : من بين الخلائق

words: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The act for which they abandon their wives is intercourse with women; min may explain what was created for them.
rows.anchor: أي تتركون لهذا الغرض { ما خلق لكم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He also allows min to be partitive, with the created part in question being the female sexual organ.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن تكون مبغضةن ويكون المخلوق كذلك هو القبل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They did not abandon their wives altogether but left them during sex by turning to males; they evade the point by construing leave as total abandonment.
rows.anchor: حملا لقوله على الترك أصلا ورأسا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot rejects their evasion: they exceed the limit by turning from wives to males, and transgression is already rooted in them.
rows.anchor: قال مضربا عن مقالهم هذا المعلوم تقديره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their transgression is exceeding the limit in evil, a settled trait that keeps them from God's bounds.
rows.anchor: العدوان - الذي هو مجاوزة الحد في الشر - وصف لكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They swear that if Lot does not stop his protest, they will expel him in a degrading public fashion.
rows.anchor: مقسمين : { لئن لم تنته } وسموه باسمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Addressing him by name instead of an honorific is deliberately harsh and coarse.
rows.anchor: وسموه باسمه جفاء غلظة فقالوا : { يا لوط }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They want personally to expel this outsider to humiliate him and be rid of objections, following their custom of exiling critics; God instead brings him out honorably through angels.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى أنه غريب عندهم , وأن عادتهم المستمرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The emphatic inna, lām, and min reinforce Lot's firm, public hatred, undeterred by their threat.
rows.anchor: ولم يقلك قال بل زاد في التأكيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He is famed for abhorring the vile act; qalāʾ is intense hatred, as if it fries the heart.
rows.anchor: والقلاءك بغض شديد كأنه يقلي الفؤاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot turns to the all-capable, all-knowing Lord and asks rescue from the punishment incurred by their deeds.
rows.anchor: وهو القادر على كل شيء العالم بكل شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God answered Lot's prayer and took him from their town when they disrespected him; destruction was delayed until his departure for his sake.
rows.anchor: بإخراجنا له من بلدهم حين ستخفافهم له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All of his household means his family and those who followed his religion.
rows.anchor: أي أهل بيته والمتبعين له على دينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The old woman was Lot's wife, who remained among those who suffered the destruction.
rows.anchor: وهي امرأته , كائنة { في } حكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She was not saved because she did not follow Lot's religion and sympathized with her people, as decreed from eternity.
rows.anchor: لقضائنا بذلك في الأزل , لكونها لم تتابعه في الدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is impossible for devils to bring down any Qur'an: it is wholly good and blessing, while they are the source of evil and ruin.
rows.anchor: أي ما يصح وما يتصور منهم النزول بشيء منه لأنه خير كله وبركة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qur'an and devils are complete opposites, so devils have no approach to it.
rows.anchor: وأنت سكينة ونور , وهم زلزلة وثبور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Devils are cut off from true hearing in the highest assembly by the guarded sky and their essential difference from angels, pure good and light.
rows.anchor: بما حفظت به السماء من الشهب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What they steal becomes confused and mostly false, so it cannot be trusted.
rows.anchor: فلا يسمعون إلا خطفان فيصير - بما يسبق إلى افهامهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He allows that the barrier may also cover hearing from believers who share some angelic light and goodness.
rows.anchor: ولا يبعد أن يكون ذلك عاما حتى يشمل السماع من المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He cites reports that reciting Ayat al-Kursi keeps a devil from approaching a home or makes him leave, and that the last two verses of al-Baqara have a similar effect.
rows.anchor: من أنها لا تقرأ في بيت فيقربه شيطان

rows.speaker: النبي ﷺ
rows.claim: The Prophet told Umar that Satan never sees him take one path without taking a different path.
rows.anchor: ما رآك الشيطان سالكا فجا إلا سلك فجا غير فجك

words: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since devils call to false gods while the Qur'an calls to the true God, the warning against associating another god follows.
rows.anchor: ولما كان تقديره أنهم إلى الطواغيت الباطلة يدعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wisdom of adding akhir after another god was explained earlier at the end of Surat al-Furqan.
rows.anchor: في آخر الفرقان حكمة الإتيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning presents punishment as the consequence of association and stresses God's ability to carry out His will easily.
rows.anchor: من القادر على ما يريد بأيسر أمر وأسهل

words: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though addressed to Muhammad, the warning gently teaches others and deters them; it urges every Qur'an hearer to reflect on its meaning and purpose.
rows.anchor: وخاطب نبيه عليه الصلاة والسلام وهو أكرم الخلق لديه

words: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every listener should see how wholly the Qur'an differs from devils' error and accords with the state of angels and those near to God.
rows.anchor: وهذا الكلام لكل من سمع القرآن في الحث على تدبره

words: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He says the warning may address the protected Prophet himself to intensify the call to follow guidance and avoid ruin.
rows.anchor: لعله خاطب به المعصوم
